name: Easton Royal
strengths: Royal tracks and finishes contested deep balls — one-handed snag through coverage shows late hands and body control.
Royal's 5-11 / 200 frame plays through contact after the catch; YAC comes from power + suddenness, not just speed.
Royal creates vertical separation and wins as a true perimeter weapon, not only a gadget slot.
weaknesses: Royal still needs cleaner consistency on intermediate dig/option routes when corners sit on the first move.
comparison: Royal comps to Deebo Samuel — 5-11 / 6-0 thick WR mold; sudden after the catch, contested-catch toughness, and enough mass to punish tackle angles.
projection: Royal projects as a Year 1 special-teams / package WR who grows into Year 2 rotation snaps, with Year 3 every-down starter ceiling as a physical perimeter weapon in the SEC.
schemeFit: Royal fits Faulkner as a boundary/slot hybrid who can take verticals and manufactured touches after the catch.
